# Settings reference (`aap.yaml`)

Every setting maps to one environment variable; a variable already set wins over the file. The file holds no
secrets: credentials come from the secret store (`aap secrets put`, Kubernetes secrets, Key Vault).

| `aap.yaml` key | Environment variable | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|
| `env` | `AAP_ENV` | `development` / `production` |
| `public_url` | `AAP_PUBLIC_URL` | pattern `^https?://` |
| `database.url_file` | `AAP_DATABASE_URL_FILE` | string — Path to a file holding the database URL (e.g. a mounted Kubernetes secret) |
| `auth.mode` | `AAP_AUTH_MODE` | `oidc` / `dev` |
| `auth.oidc.issuer` | `AAP_OIDC_ISSUER` | pattern `^https?://` |
| `auth.oidc.client_id` | `AAP_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | string |
| `auth.oidc.tenant_id` | `AAP_OIDC_TENANT_ID` | string |
| `auth.oidc.api_audience` | `AAP_OIDC_API_AUDIENCE` | string |
| `auth.oidc.client_auth` | `AAP_OIDC_CLIENT_AUTH` | `managed_identity` / `secret` |
| `auth.oidc.internal_url` | `AAP_OIDC_INTERNAL_URL` | pattern `^https?://[^/]+/?$` — back-channel origin for discovery, keys and token calls |
| `secrets.backend` | `AAP_SECRETS_BACKEND` | `file` / `mounted` / `keyvault` |
| `secrets.dir` | `AAP_SECRETS_DIR` | string |
| `secrets.keyvault_url` | `AAP_KEYVAULT_URL` | pattern `^https://` |
| `rules.dir` | `AAP_RULES_DIR` | string — Directory with your own rules files, laid out like the repository (config/..., catalogue/...): only the files you change; the rest are the defaults shipped in the image. The Helm chart sets it from rules.files |
| `worker.scheduler_interval` | `AAP_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL` | integer — Seconds between scheduler sweeps: integration syncs that are due, deadline breaches, exception expiry, re-evaluation, snapshot refresh and evidence chain verification (default 300) |
| `evidence_store.kind` | `AAP_BLOB_KIND` | `local` / `azure` / `s3` |
| `evidence_store.root` | `AAP_BLOB_ROOT` | string |
| `evidence_store.container` | `AAP_BLOB_CONTAINER` | string |
| `evidence_store.account_url` | `AAP_BLOB_ACCOUNT_URL` | pattern `^https://` |
| `evidence_store.bucket` | `AAP_BLOB_S3_BUCKET` | string |
| `evidence_store.prefix` | `AAP_BLOB_S3_PREFIX` | string |
| `evidence_store.endpoint_url` | `AAP_BLOB_S3_ENDPOINT` | pattern `^https?://` |
| `evidence_store.region` | `AAP_BLOB_S3_REGION` | string |
| `azure.client_id` | `AAP_AZURE_CLIENT_ID` | string — User-assigned managed identity client id |
| `plugins.github.org` | `AAP_GITHUB_ORG` | string |
| `plugins.github.app_client_id` | `AAP_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID` | string |
| `plugins.github.app_key_id` | `AAP_GITHUB_APP_KEY_ID` | string — Key Vault key id of the App's signing key |
| `plugins.github.api_url` | `AAP_GITHUB_API` | pattern `^https://` |
| `plugins.jira.url` | `AAP_JIRA_URL` | pattern `^https?://` |
| `plugins.jira.email` | `AAP_JIRA_EMAIL` | string |
| `plugins.dependency_track.url` | `AAP_DT_URL` | pattern `^https?://` |
| `plugins.defectdojo.url` | `AAP_DD_URL` | pattern `^https?://` |
| `plugins.azure_defender.subscriptions` | `AAP_AZURE_SUBSCRIPTIONS` | array |
| `plugins.aws_securityhub.role_arn` | `AAP_AWS_ROLE_ARN` | pattern `^arn:aws` |
| `plugins.aws_securityhub.accounts` | `AAP_AWS_ACCOUNTS` | array |
| `plugins.aws_securityhub.web_identity_audience` | `AAP_AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_AUDIENCE` | string |
| `plugins.sentinel.dce` | `AAP_SENTINEL_DCE` | pattern `^https://` |
| `plugins.sentinel.dcr_id` | `AAP_SENTINEL_DCR_ID` | string |
| `plugins.siem_http.url` | `AAP_SIEM_HTTP_URL` | pattern `^https://` |
| `plugins.siem_http.format` | `AAP_SIEM_HTTP_FORMAT` | `json` / `splunk_hec` |
| `plugins.syslog.address` | `AAP_SIEM_SYSLOG` | pattern `^[^:/ ]+:[0-9]{1,5}$` |
| `plugins.syslog.ca_file` | `AAP_SIEM_SYSLOG_CA` | string |
| `plugins.gitlab.url` | `AAP_GITLAB_URL` | pattern `^https?://` |
| `plugins.gitlab.group` | `AAP_GITLAB_GROUP` | string |
| `plugins.github_issues.enabled` | `AAP_GITHUB_ISSUES` | `on` |
